posts.title: Back to Synik 30
posts.description: After about a year of using CTactical bags, I started feeling as if something was “off.” Could be comfort, could be lack of organization, or could be something else. Sometimes, it’s not the bag. “It’s not you , it’s me .”

posts.title: Traveling with the CT21+
posts.description: So, is my new dream bag, the CT21+, the perfect 1-2 day travel bag? TL;DR: No, it’s not. Recently had to take a very quick trip to the west coast… which from Gainesville means a full day travel, one night in a hotel, and then if you really want to see your kid (which I do), taking the red-eye and flying at night (and hopefully sleeping).

posts.title: Thoughts on ClueCon 2026
posts.description: Earlier this month, I attended ClueCon 2026 in Chicago. The event was well attended with open source RTC/VoIP community members. Any opportunity I get to spend time with Daniel-Constantin Mierla is well worth the trip. =)
